protocol.pairing: Identical initial typed arrays cloned for every force, timestep and softening variant at a given N and seed.
protocol.quantiles: Current diagnostics use interpolated number and inverse mass-CDF quantiles; legacy number median is additionally recorded.
protocol.timing: Wall times include diagnostics and may overlap other host activity. These are experiment costs, not isolated hardware benchmarks.
protocol.potentialConvention: N-body energy: one half sum m_i Phi_i with exact softened pair Phi excluding self. Fixed field: sum m_i Phi_analytic, without factor one half.
protocol.caveat: Smooth controls are unsoftened, while N-body uses Plummer softening; their difference does not isolate discreteness alone.
